label: Round Patch
description: The round-bottomed patch breast pocket softens the geometry of the jacket front by replacing square-cut corners with a continuous curve that sweeps around the pocket's lower edge. This curvaceous shape is a hallmark of Neapolitan tailoring and echoes the rounded patch pockets sometimes used at the hip, giving the jacket a coherent, relaxed Italian personality. It is the natural choice on soft, unconstructed jackets in linen or open-weave cloth where angular details would look out of character.
